title: the best simple visual habit tracker
body: i’ve been looking for an app that can show me the micro-logs of my habit/s. it helps with staying consistent because the visual streak is encouraging to keep going even if you take a single minute for that habit. its even better if you’re building multiple habits at once! it’s fun to look at and aesthetically pleasing.
author: sg19__

title: Widget options
body: Itd be nice if i could add a widget per habit category instead of individual habits. Its such a chore to add widgets one by one for each habit especially if you have a lot tracked. Itd also be nice if i could share the data across my other ios devices such as my IPad.
author: im really sad abt this

title: BEST HABIT TRACKER
body:
Very straight forward and easy to track habit with this app. Good for people who are minimalist yet wants to have a fully functional tracker.

Here what I truly like in the app:
✅ Unli habit tracker + advance options
✅ Reports per habit
✅ Customizable notification 
✅ Home screen widget
✅ Very cheap compare to other trackers
✅ And most important (for me) very minimalist

author: JM ARBY

title: Best Habit Tracking App
body:
Unlike most tracking apps that has so many features, to the point that it becomes distracting, HabitKit is clutter-free without ever feeling lacking. Updating the app is seamless, and actually being able to see all the little squares of all the days I’ve done something makes me prouder than just seeing a number streak. Even with the free version, you already have so much to work with, and there aren’t any ads! 

Can’t wait to buy the lifetime version. Just wanted to leave a review because I’ve never felt this strongly about an app. Great job to the developer! 😭🫶
author: Namie Andō
